items.name: Cojedes Cubing 2018

venue.name: Centro Comercial La Casona Plaza
venue.address: Calle Manrique, entre Calle Sucre y Calle Páez, Frente a la Plaza Bolívar de San Carlos, San Carlos 2201, Cojedes, Venez

items.information: El torneo se realizará en el 2do Piso (Feria de Comida) del Centro Comercial **Casona Plaza**, en San Carlos, Estado Cojedes. El evento cuenta con dos (02) preventas, por motivos inflacionarios. Hasta el 28 de Noviembre: **100 BsS** Del 29 de Noviembre al 11 de Diciembre: **150 BsS** Este monto debe debe abonarse previamente para aparecer en la lista de competidores. **(Por favor consulte pestaña "Pagos")** Después del cierre del registro. Sólo se permitirá participar en 3x3, si hay espacios disponibles. The competition will be held at CC La Casona Plaza, 2nd Floor (Food Court) on San Carlos, Cojedes. There will be **two (02) prices** for inflationary reasons: Until Noviembre 28th: **100 BsS** From November 29th to December 11th: **150 BsS** The competition fee must be paid in advance, once is verified you'll appears on Competitors list. **(Please Check "Payment Tab")** On the spot registration is possible if there are available spots, but only in 3x3x3 Cube.

items.name: New Zealand Nationals 2018

venue.name: [AUT City Campus] (https://www.aut.ac.nz/__data/assets/pdf_file/0011/118919/AUT-campus-map-city-web-v10.pdf)
venue.address: Room WA224, AUT City Campus, 55 Wellesley Street East, Auckland
venue.details: Room WA224, This is the Wellesley Street east (City campus), Building A, on the second floor room 05

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2018 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In Addition New Zealand Nationals 2018 will crown the National Champions in 17 events of the World Cube Associations 18 over the course of 3 days.

items.name: Skillcon 2018

venue.name: [Rio Hotel and Casino](https://www.caesars.com/rio-las-vegas)
venue.address: 3700 W. Flamingo Road Las Vegas, NV 89103

items.information: This is a WCA competition presented in conjunction with SkillCon 2018. Check the [SkillCon website](http://skillcon.org/) for more info on the other events and seminars that will be going on. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, you may want to [watch this competitor tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww). **Before registering, you must read the "Competitor Responsibilities" tab.** This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition.
